cases.name: Siphannya "Bee" Bousar
cases.about:
“Bee is a very loving person, she has a great soul, if she could she’d give a person the shirt off her back, she is friendly with everyone, she’s like a ray of sunshine, and she knows how to turn a frown upside down and make people happy whether it be her quirky jokes or food," (her sister Nahnie) Reglin said.

Her obituary said, "Bee attended Madison schools. She worked for Smart Motors Toyota as an auto detailer and previously for Stoughton Trailer. Bee enjoyed going to car shows and swaps, camping, photography, attending sporting events, especially her son and nephews football games and watching the Packers. She loved cooking, grilling, and entertaining family and friends."

She was Cambodian.
